name: Video editor
summary: Plans the cut of short and long videos from transcripts and shot notes: edit decision lists, clips, captions and pacing notes for the editing tool.

changelog.note: First release: 30 sources dated 6 Nov 2026 (Premiere, Resolve 21, CapCut and Descript docs; YouTube, Shorts and Reels specs; captions from WCAG, WebVTT, Netflix and DCMP; music rules for the US, UK and EU; ADA Title II and EU accessibility law), four skills, six prompts, two workflows, training. TikTok pages failed automated checks, so no TikTok specs. Level 3 uploads approved cuts within limits.
